name: test_exact_thread_recipient_guard_rejects_missing_expected_copy
description:
Objective: Exact thread recipient guard rejects missing expected copy.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/notifications/test_notification_portal_page.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Execute `test_exact_thread_recipient_guard_rejects_missing_expected_copy` exactly as defined in tests/unit/notifications/test_notification_portal_page.py:216.
5. Evaluate the encoded observable UI/service checks: `assert_thread_delivery_recipients`.
6. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `pytest.raises(AssertionError, match='routing changed')`.
7. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Exact thread recipient guard rejects missing expected copy.
2. The encoded UI/service checks pass: Thread delivery recipients.
3. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `pytest.raises(AssertionError, match='routing changed')`.
4. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
